description: A DSP48E1 with AUTORESET_PATDET = "RESET_NOT_MATCH" writes AUTORESET_PATDET_RESET as well
exercises: the AUTORESET_PATDET features of a DSP48E1 in the FASM writer
a DSP48E1 instantiated by hand, not inferred by yosys
why: prjxray's 100-dsp-mskpat fuzzer tags AUTORESET_PATDET_RESET for RESET_MATCH and for RESET_NOT_MATCH, and AUTORESET_PATDET_RESET_NOT_MATCH for the second one only; Vivado writes both features for RESET_NOT_MATCH. The engine wrote only the second one, so a DSP that resets on the inverted pattern came out of the writer with half of its configuration missing, and the bitstream assembled all the same.
